definitions.gloss: taking part in; siding with (usually something wrong)
definitions.explanation: Joining in or helping with a plan or act, usually a bad one such as a crime or a fraud. In older use also taking someone's side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{加担|かたん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To take part in a crime.
He refused to be a party to the wrongdoing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧うち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{加担|かたん}⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{分|わ}かって→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ショック→ショック：03847_shokku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: She was shocked to learn she had been unknowingly helping a fraud.

notes:
Takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{加担|かたん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. The thing joined is nearly always bad, so the word carries blame. Also written {荷担|かたん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{加担|かたん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take part in a crime
- ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{加担|かたん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be party to wrongdoing
- ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{加担|かたん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take part in a war

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{加|くわ}わる→加わる：01940_kuwawaru⟧: to join; neutral, for any group or activity
- ⟦{協力|きょうりょく}する→協力する：25370_kyouryokusuru⟧: to cooperate; positive
